answer: Duplicating identities requires repeating the costly ascent and burning fresh stake per sybil, so forging a thousand nodes multiplies real-world travel and capital far beyond any reward, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique basalt token mined only at a physical summit relay, then publish a signed relic of that climb tied to its key. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
